mapper.sql: select u.id, u.dept_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.email, u.avatar, u.phone_number, u.password, u.sex, u.status, u.del_flag, u.last_login_ip, u.last_login_time, u.password_update_time, u.create_by, u.create_time, u.update_by, u.update_time, u.remark, u.creator_id, u.updater_id, d.id as dept_id, d.parent_id, d.ancestors, d.dept_name, d.order_num, d.leader, d.status as dept_status, r.id as role_id, r.role_name, r.role_key, r.role_sort, r.data_scope, r.status as role_status from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.id left join sys_user_role ur on u.id = ur.user_id left join sys_role r on r.id = ur.role_id
mapper.select:
select distinct u.id, u.dept_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.email, u.phone_number, u.status, u.create_time from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.id inner join sys_user_role ur on u.id = ur.user_id where u.del_flag = '0' and ur.role_id = #{query.roleId}
and u.user_name like concat('%', #{query.userName}, '%')
and u.phone_number like concat('%', #{query.phoneNumber}, '%')
${query.params.dataScope} order by u.create_time desc, u.id desc

select u.id, u.dept_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.email, u.phone_number, u.status, u.create_time from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.id where u.del_flag = '0' and not exists ( select 1 from sys_user_role ur where ur.user_id = u.id and ur.role_id = #{query.roleId} )
and u.user_name like concat('%', #{query.userName}, '%')
and u.phone_number like concat('%', #{query.phoneNumber}, '%')
${query.params.dataScope} order by u.create_time desc, u.id desc

select u.id, u.dept_id, u.nick_name, u.user_name, u.email, u.avatar, u.phone_number, u.sex, u.status, u.del_flag, u.last_login_ip, u.last_login_time, u.create_by, u.create_time, u.update_by, u.update_time, u.creator_id, u.updater_id, u.remark, d.dept_name, d.leader from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.id where u.del_flag = '0'
AND u.id = #{id}
AND u.user_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%')
AND u.status = #{status}
AND u.phone_number like concat('%', #{phoneNumber}, '%')
AND date_format(u.create_time,'%Y%m%d') >= date_format(#{params.beginTime},'%Y%m%d')
AND date_format(u.create_time,'%Y%m%d') <= date_format(#{params.endTime},'%Y%m%d')
AND (u.dept_id = #{deptId} OR u.dept_id IN ( SELECT t.id FROM sys_dept t WHERE find_in_set(#{deptId}, ancestors) ))
${params.dataScope} order by u.create_time desc, u.id desc

select distinct u.id, u.dept_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.email, u.phone_number, u.status, u.create_time from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.id left join sys_user_role ur on u.id = ur.user_id left join sys_role r on r.id = ur.role_id where u.del_flag = '0' and r.id = #{roleId}
AND u.user_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%')
AND u.phone_number like concat('%', #{phoneNumber}, '%')
${params.dataScope} order by u.create_time desc, u.id desc

select distinct u.id, u.dept_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.email, u.phone_number, u.status, u.create_time from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.id left join sys_user_role ur on u.id = ur.user_id left join sys_role r on r.id = ur.role_id where u.del_flag = '0' and (r.id != #{roleId} or r.id IS NULL) and u.id not in (select u.id from sys_user u inner join sys_user_role ur on u.id = ur.user_id and ur.role_id = #{roleId})
AND u.user_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%')
AND u.phone_number like concat('%', #{phoneNumber}, '%')
${params.dataScope} order by u.create_time desc, u.id desc
select id, user_name from sys_user where user_name = #{userName} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
select id, phone_number from sys_user where phone_number = #{phoneNumber} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
select id, email from sys_user where email = #{email} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
mapper.update: update sys_user set last_login_ip = #{lastLoginIp}, last_login_time = #{lastLoginTime} where id = #{userId}
